title: One-step tape radius bound
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be an oracle language, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes. Choose a work-tape index $i$ and a natural number $n$. If the head on tape $i$ is at distance at most $n$ from the origin, and every cell $z$ with $|z|\ge n$ on that tape is blank, then after one step relative to $O$ the head on tape $i$ is at distance at most $n+1$ from the origin, and every cell $z$ with $|z|\ge n+1$ on that tape is blank.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes
A tape index $i$ among the $k+1$ tapes
The head position on tape $i$ has absolute value at most $n$
Every cell on tape $i$ at absolute position at least $n$ is blank
